title: Approvals
description: Actions an AI agent may not take until a person approves them.
emptyPending: No pending approvals. Nothing needs your review right now.

card.pointsTo: This file is a link. It points to <res>{path}</res>.
card.reasonPolicy: A published policy rule required approval
card.reasonRiskCeiling: The risk score exceeded this task's ceiling
card.ceilingContext: Final score {score} against this task's ceiling of {ceiling}.
card.paramsIntro: The exact invocation parameters this request is bound to. Credential-shaped values are withheld by key name; this is not full content inspection.
card.paramsTruncated: This payload was too large to show in full. You are looking at an incomplete object.
card.paramsRedacted: {count, plural, one {# value withheld} other {# values withheld}}:
card.digestHint: The exact value an issued grant is bound to. Any change to the parameters produces a different digest and invalidates the grant.
card.noDecisionRecorded: No decision was recorded on this request.
card.grantHint: Redeemed means the agent presented the grant to run this action. It does not mean the action succeeded; the outcome is in the audit trail.
card.effectUnknown: This action could not be matched to the tool registry, so whether it reads, changes or destroys data is unknown.
card.effectFromRegistry: From the tool registry's current definition, not recorded with the request.

decide.sent: Your answer is held for 10 seconds, then sent.

detail.notFoundBody: No approval request with this ID was found in this workspace's approvals list.

categoryNote: Action type comes from the tool registry's current definition, not from what was recorded with each request.

handover.title: Temporary password
handover.intro: This action set a temporary password. Only you, as the approver, can see it, and only once. Give it to the person directly; the agent never sees it.
handover.confirmBody: You can see this once. Manar deletes it as soon as it is shown, and it disappears when you leave this page.
handover.shownNotice: Manar no longer holds this value. Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
handover.gone: There is nothing to show. The temporary password was already collected, it expired after 24 hours, or the action has not run yet.
handover.forbidden: Only the person who approved this request can see its temporary password.
handover.unavailable: The temporary password could not be fetched right now. Nothing was shown or deleted. Try again in a moment.

queue.title: Approvals
queue.description: The oldest request is first. J and K move, A approves once, D denies.
queue.loadFailed: We could not load your approvals.
queue.sourceDevice: A tool on one of your devices
queue.keys: Keys: J next, K previous, A approve once, D deny. Approving for 8 hours or making a rule needs a click.

history.title: Approval history
history.descriptionAll: Every request, from agents and devices, newest first.
history.descriptionOwn: Requests from your own devices and agents, newest first.
history.loadError: We could not load the history.

state.noAnswerDevice: No answer: the device stopped waiting

end.paused: AI was paused for the workspace.
end.withdrawn: The device stopped waiting after 2 minutes.
end.superseded: A newer request for the same action replaced it.
end.agent_not_live: The agent was no longer active.
end.task_execution_limit_reached: The task had used up its allowed actions.

history.usedAt: Received by the device or agent {when}
history.revokeUnused: The device or agent has not used it yet. Revoking cancels it now, so nothing will run.
history.revokeUsed: It was already used, so the action may have run. Revoking marks it "revoked after use", alerts your workspace approvers, and blocks this exact action until someone lifts the block.
history.revokedAfterUseToast: Revoked. Your approvers were alerted and this action is blocked until someone lifts it.
history.withdrawnToast: Withdrawn. The next request asks a person again.
history.notAllowed: You can't do that here. Nothing was changed.
history.actionFailed: That didn't go through. Nothing was changed. Try again.
history.hiddenCharacters: Contains hidden or direction-changing characters (shown as �).

conflict.paused: AI is paused for this workspace, so nothing can be approved. Nothing was changed. Resume AI first, or deny the request.
conflict.already_decided: Someone already answered this request. Nothing was changed.
conflict.expired: This request expired before your answer arrived. Nothing was changed.
conflict.revoked: This approval was revoked. Nothing was changed.
conflict.not_approved: Only an approved request can be revoked. Nothing was changed.
conflict.action_already_used: This button was already used. Nothing was changed.
conflict.not_signaled: Your answer could not be confirmed. Check this request again in a moment before answering again.
conflict.forbidden: You can't answer this request. Nothing was changed.
conflict.failed: Your answer didn't go through. Nothing was changed. Try again.
conflict.outcomeDiffers: Someone else's answer, or Manar's re-check, took effect first. Check the request in History.
conflict.reauth: Confirm it's you (sign in again) to approve your own high-risk request. Nothing was changed.
